notes.title: Update 3.0.0
notes.content:
The PVP Arena has been completely reworked.
A new scientist NPC has been introduced.
A new faction has been added, accessible in the late game.
Numerous new ships and modules have been added.
Game mechanics and AI behavior have been improved.

notes.title: Update 2.9.4
notes.content:
A new ship equipped with unique weapons
 Support ships capable of repairing allies during battles
 Added Mercenary behavior options: Aggressive and Defensive
 Numerous bugs fixed, improving stability and performance across the game
 Many enhancements to game mechanics, weapon systems, and AI behavior
